text: Saves IPs, ports, and passwords for hosts so you can connect instantly without re-entering them
quote: No more re-entering IPs, ports, or password. Everything is saved, so you connect instantly.

text: Set a jump host on a group and every host in it automatically connects through that jump host
quote: if you configure a jump host for a Group, every Host within it will automatically connect through that jump host

text: Keychain credentials can be referenced by multiple hosts and groups without duplicating them
quote: Items in the Keychain can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them.

text: Broadcast a command to all open sessions at the same time
quote: You can broadcast a command to all sessions simultaneously and save the entire setup as a reusable template.

text: Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into one environment and can broadcast the same input to them
quote: Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into one focused environment... Broadcast the same input to multiple sessions

text: Save workspaces as reusable templates that capture connections, tab names, layout, working directories, and running commands
quote: Workspace templates capture: Included connections, Tab names, Layout configuration, Working directories, Running commands at the time of saving

text: Run saved snippets on multiple hosts at once
quote: execute them on multiple hosts at once from the Snippets screen

text: Save labeled shell scripts as snippets and run them on different hosts without retyping
quote: In Termius, a snippet is a labeled shell script that you can save and run on different hosts without retyping it.

text: Run a startup snippet automatically each time you connect to a host
quote: Run a startup snippet each time you connect to a host

text: Uses AI to generate shell commands from plain-language descriptions
quote: Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command... Termius generates the command using AI.

text: Records terminal session logs automatically for every host, syncs and shares them with the team, and lets you search and bookmark them
quote: Termius automatically collects terminal session logs for every host. Logs are synced across devices and shared with your team. You can search logs and save them using Bookmarks.

text: Each account has a private personal vault that syncs across all your devices
quote: Every account includes a Personal vault, accessible only to you and synced across all your devices.

text: End-to-end encrypted cloud vaults store hosts, keys, snippets, port forwarding rules, and known hosts, and sync them across devices
quote: Vaults in Termius are the end-to-end encrypted cloud storage for Hosts, Keys, Snippets, Port Forwarding rules, and Known Hosts. Vaults enable sync across devices

text: Adding team members automatically creates a shared team vault for managing infrastructure together
quote: When you add team members, a Team vault is created automatically. This vault is shared with all team members, allowing your team to manage infrastructure together.

text: Team vaults act as a single source of truth for hosts, groups, snippets, port forwarding rules, and credentials, updated in real time
quote: Vaults serve as a single source of truth for Hosts, Groups, Snippets, Port Forwarding rules, and Credentials, which are stored securely and updated in real time.

text: Create multiple vaults to separate data by team, project, or environment, and control who can access each one
quote: Use them to separate data by team, project, or environment, and define who can access each vault.

text: Multiplayer terminal sessions let teammates collaborate in the same terminal in real time
quote: Collaborate in the terminal in real-time using the multiplayer sessions. Troubleshoot together or guide teammates through your workflow.

text: Built-in autocomplete suggests snippets, shell history, paths, and commands with arguments without third-party packages
quote: suggest snippets, shell history commands, paths, and built-in commands with arguments... You do not need to install third-party packages

text: Create and manage passphrase-protected SSH keys that are encrypted and accessible from any device
quote: Create and manage your SSH keys with passphrase protection. Everything is encrypted and easily accessible from any device.

text: Generates Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, and ML-DSA keys
quote: Termius can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA, and ML-DSA keys.

text: Generates FIDO2 and biometric keys and exports public keys to authorized_keys
quote: Generate SSH keys, FIDO2 keys, and Biometric keys; Provide a convenient way to export the public keys to the `authorized_keys` file

text: Supports SSH authentication with FIDO2 security keys and MFA
quote: Secure SSH authentication with FIDO2 security keys and MFA.

text: Device-bound keys protected by Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics
quote: Secure connections with device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics.

text: Stores and encrypts infrastructure locally and connects directly to servers without internet, a proxy, or a VPN
quote: Termius doesn't depend on the cloud to manage your access. Your infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally. Connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN.

text: Imports the ~/.ssh folder, including ssh_config, known_hosts, and key files
quote: Termius supports importing the contents of the `~/.ssh` folder, including `ssh_config`, `known_hosts`, and key files

text: Imports hosts from CSV, including labels, IPs, protocols, ports, groups, subgroups, tags, and credentials
quote: Termius can import hosts from a CSV file, including labels, IP addresses, protocols, ports, groups, subgroups, tags, and credentials.

text: Supports local, remote, and dynamic port forwarding, with rules managed in a UI and toggled on or off by double-click
quote: Termius supports all three main types of port forwarding (local, remote, and dynamic)... start or stop a specific rule with a double-click.

text: Desktop dual-pane SFTP lets you manage local and remote files side by side
quote: Dual-pane interface on the desktop: manage local or remote files side-by-side

text: Switch between a terminal session and an SFTP session for the same host in one click
quote: Integrated workflow: switch between a terminal session and an SFTP session for the same host with a single click

text: Sends KEY=VALUE environment variables to the remote shell on connect, like OpenSSH SendEnv
quote: Termius sends them automatically on connect, using the same mechanism as OpenSSH's `SendEnv` client-side directive.

text: Long-press and drag on the terminal screen to move the cursor in any direction
quote: Long-press the terminal screen and drag in any direction to move the cursor up, down, left, or right.

text: Organize hosts into labeled groups by customer, location, or environment
quote: A group is a labeled collection of Hosts that share a common characteristic, such as a customer, location, or environment.

text: Set default parameters on a group that apply to its hosts and subgroups
quote: Termius lets you set default parameters for hosts and subgroups within a given group.

text: Cloud Sync for a group imports matching instances from AWS, DigitalOcean, or Azure
quote: You can enable Cloud Sync for a specific group and integrate it with AWS, DigitalOcean, or Azure. Once the setup is completed, Termius syncs the matching instances

text: Includes a built-in local terminal and supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP
quote: It includes a built-in Local terminal and supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP.

text: Configure multiple protocols per host, including Mosh to keep connections stable when networks change
quote: You can configure multiple protocols for a single Host... enable Mosh when you need connection stability while changing networks

text: Available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android
quote: Termius is available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android, so you can use it across all your devices.
